operations.title: The Weil explicit formula is the global source-derived prime–gamma boundary morphism
operations.statement: On logarithmic test functions, the Weil functional combines the archimedean, endpoint, and negative intrinsic prime-power distributions and equals the completed zero-divisor functional. Its convolution-square form is positive iff RH. The radical quotient is therefore the canonical cutoff-independent source boundary quotient, formally sharing the Xi Pick Cauchy Gram kernel; extension and closability remain unproved.
operations.scope: Derives the global morphism and algebraic quotient; does not prove Weil positivity/RH, the Cauchy-domain isometry, or a closed self-adjoint operator.
